title: Local Proof Scopes and Interpretation Obstructions for iPRA

new_checker.arithmetic_basis: Inherited independent-initializer scalar iterator I; not the tied-seed B theory.
new_checker.equivalence: Preserves the inherited native calculus by lexical alpha-renaming; retains its whole-domain bi-interpretation with iPRA.

main_new_theorem.name: No finite-dimensional bi-interpretation for existential-free tied-seed theories
hypotheses: Only the numerical B term language (with its fixed descriptions and definitional abbreviations)
An existential-free axiomatization in that language
The standard B algebra on N is a model
main_new_theorem.conclusion: No ordinary finite-dimensional bi-interpretation with full first-order iPRA; arbitrary domain, equality and operation formulas are permitted.
main_new_theorem.parameter_extension: Uniform finite parameter families with provably inhabited conditions are included by adding parameters to the output tuple.
proof_ingredients: Finite tuple-witness extraction with arbitrary matrix by cut elimination
O(N^d) output-image bound for finitely many d-tuples of witness terms
The source-side return isomorphism and interpreted arithmetic tupling produce forbidden k-to-d disjoint-fiber compression.
limits: Does not exclude every one-way interpretation on an arbitrary domain
Does not cover arbitrary positive-existence axioms
Does not automatically extend to additional bounded numerical primitives, which can destroy the finite-profile invariant
Does not address nonstandard infinitary meanings of interpretation

supporting_results.name: Finite-dimensional quotient unit obstruction
supporting_results.claim: An almost-unary algebra has no infinite quotient of a finite-power subdomain with a two-sided unit operation realized by one fixed tuple of terms.
supporting_results.allows: Arbitrary subdomains, equivalence relations, and fixed parameters.
supporting_results.limit: Arbitrary formula-defined operation graphs are not covered by this theorem alone.

supporting_results.name: Finite-profile invariant
supporting_results.claim: Each B term has one active input and finite unary controls on the others.
supporting_results.limit: No restriction on unary functions at arity one.

supporting_results.name: Selector completion
supporting_results.claim: An unbounded zero selector admitted in B update descriptions gives a direct compiler for every fixed PR description.
supporting_results.limit: No smaller full checker or separate full bi-interpretation proof for B+C is claimed.

supporting_results.name: Countdown action observation
supporting_results.claim: Fixed countdown uniqueness makes zero-start successor clocks agree on every countdown observation.
supporting_results.limit: Equality of clock indices still requires an unproved faithfulness condition.
